## Purpose

What user outcome and acceptance gate does this change serve?

## Fidelity and contracts

- [ ] Source evidence/provenance remains intact; uncertainty is not hidden.
- [ ] Contract, IR/schema, migration, and compatibility impact is described.
- [ ] Preview/export use the same canonical revision, settings, persona version, and seed.

## Safety, privacy, and licensing

- [ ] Untrusted-document and browser threat impact was reviewed.
- [ ] No document content, secret, personal fixture, database, upload, or generated export is committed/logged.
- [ ] Provider/data-transfer and persona/font license changes are explicit and disabled by default where optional.
- [ ] This does not add signature cloning, identity impersonation, implicit rewriting, or automatic assignment submission.

## Verification

List commands, corpus slices, visual/print/accessibility checks, and exact results.

## Operations

Describe rollout, resource/retention/backup impact, and rollback.
